The results showed not only significant difference for CHGB23 between the patients and controls (Table 5), but also, CHGB23 gene polymorphism in male population was found to be different between leprosy patients and healthy controls. The percent of AG genotype for leprosy (51.7%) was higher than that of control (46.6%) (OR = 1.69, P = 0.058). Meanwhile, the prevalence of AA genotype for male leprosy (29.7%) was lower than that of control (33.9%) (OR = 0.214, p = 0.029). Furthermore, stratified by gender, the frequency of AA for male leprosy (34.4%) was lower than that of male control (44.7%) (OR = 0.142, P = 0.003).
